notes.title: HOTFIX + PATCH NOTES v1.0.3.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889260/3d0a8958af7975456d815d9514a5bcc342065591.png[/img]

[b]HOTFIX + PATCH NOTES[/b]

🛠️ [b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] The final [b]Story Mode[/b] map is now loaded when completing Very Hard difficulty.
[*] The [b]Achievement[/b] for completing Very Hard difficulty is now unlockable on Steam.
[*] [b]Ranked Mode[/b] is now unlocked by completing Very Hard difficulty in Story Mode (Let's Jump!).
[*] The time for the mosquito to disappear after attacking is now corrected.
[/list]

🎮 [b]Balancing:[/b]
[list]
[*] NPCs now appear earlier in the levels.
[*] Easy difficulty now has fewer maps.
[/list]

☀️ [b]Quality of life:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improvements in the interaction with the [b]family[/b] when completing [b]Story Mode[/b] (Let's Jump!).
[*] The Progress Bar that indicates the next difficulty has been increased on the HUD for better readability.
[*] The hitbox for collecting Upgrades has been increased.
[*] Mosquitoes now have VFX when they disappear.
[/list]

notes.title: Devlog #0 is out! Explore the journey behind the creation of our game!
notes.content:
In this devlog we dive into the journey of how we get into game development, how we made our indie game from scratch, the initial concepts, mechanics, environment, enemies, 3D art, showing behind-the-scenes footage and the step by step of the development process, from prototype to current state.

Check how our plans changed from a two-week "self game jam" to 9 months developing this game project.

This game is a fast-paced yet relaxing 3D Precision Platformer, that uses procedural generation for the maps, and blends elements of endless runners. You can jump between mushrooms, gather Power-ups, dodge Enemies, earn Emblems to spend in Upgrades, and break distance and time Records!

Please let us know, what do you want to see in the next devlog?
